title: COSI Metadata (v1.2)
description: JSON Schema for the `metadata.json` file of a Composable OS Image (COSI), COSI Specification revision 1.2. Derived from docs/Reference/Composable-OS-Image.md. Per the spec, readers MUST ignore unknown fields, so this schema does not forbid additional properties.

version.description: The version of the metadata schema, in MAJOR.MINOR form. This schema targets revision 1.2.

osArch.description: The architecture of the OS, using the names reported by `uname -m`. Case-insensitive; common aliases are accepted.

images.description: Filesystem metadata for each filesystem in the image.

osPackages.description: The list of packages installed in the OS.

bootloader.description: Information about the bootloader used by the OS.

id.description: A unique identifier for the COSI file (UUID, case-insensitive).

compression.description: Compression metadata for the COSI file.

path.description: Path of the compressed image file inside the tar file. MUST start with `images/`.

compressedSize.description: Size of the compressed image in bytes.

uncompressedSize.description: Size of the raw uncompressed image in bytes.

sha384.description: SHA-384 hash of the compressed image (96 hex characters, case-insensitive).

image.description: Details of the hash partition image file in the tar file.
Details of the image file in the tar file.

mountPoint.description: The mount point of the filesystem.

fsType.description: The filesystem type, using the name recognized by the kernel.

fsUuid.description: The UUID of the filesystem. Can be a proper UUID or a filesystem-specific identifier (e.g. a FAT volume serial such as `C3D4-250D`). MUST be unique across all filesystems.

partType.description: The GPT partition type, as a UUID (case-insensitive). The ESP MUST be `c12a7328-f81f-11d2-ba4b-00a0c93ec93b`. Defaults to Generic Linux Data `0fc63daf-8483-4772-8e79-3d69d8477de4` when the type cannot be determined.

verity.description: The verity metadata of the filesystem. MUST be specified if the OS opens this filesystem with dm-verity; otherwise omitted or null.

size.description: Size of the original disk in bytes. MUST be a multiple of `lbaSize`.

type.description: Partitioning type of the original disk. Currently only `gpt` is supported.

lbaSize.description: The size of a logical block address (LBA) in bytes. Generally 512.

gptRegions.description: Regions in the GPT disk, ordered by increasing start LBA (primary-gpt first). Required when `type` == `gpt`.

image.description: Details of the image file in the tar file.

type.description: The type of region this image represents.

number.description: The partition's GPT entry index (1-based). Required when `type` == `partition`.

version.description: The version of the package installed.

systemdBoot.description: systemd-boot configuration. Required when `type` == `systemd-boot`; otherwise omitted or null.

entries.description: The contents of the `loader/entries/*.conf` files in the systemd-boot EFI partition.

path.description: Absolute path (from the root FS) to the UKI or config.

maxWindowLog.description: The maximum zstd `windowLog` (the power-of-2 exponent, not the window size in bytes) used across all images in the COSI file.
